title: Notion sync
description: Connect Notion and sync WakeMark bookmarks into a structured database with auto-sync for paid plans.

hero.title: Notion sync
hero.subtitle: Push AI-tagged bookmarks into a Notion database — manually or automatically.

overview.title: What you get
overview.p1: WakeMark creates a Wakemark Bookmarks database in the Notion page you choose, with title, author, URL, tags, created date, and media flags.
overview.p2: Each bookmark page includes the tweet quote, AI summary, outbound links, and media references as blocks.

setup.title: Setup
setup.step2: Open Settings → Notion sync and click Connect Notion.
setup.step3: Search for a parent page and create the Wakemark Bookmarks database.
setup.step4: Enable Auto-sync to backfill unsynced bookmarks and keep new ones flowing in.

manual.title: Manual export
manual.p1: On the bookmarks board, select items and choose Export to Notion. WakeMark queues the sync in the background using batched jobs.

limits.title: Rate limits and reliability
limits.p1: Large first-time syncs run in batches of 15 bookmarks with short delays to respect Notion API limits and Vercel timeouts.
limits.p2: If a batch fails, QStash retries automatically with exponential backoff.
